categories.name: wallet
categories.evidence: Changes PSBT manipulation logic in PartiallySignedTransaction::AddInput to drop invalid Taproot and MuSig2 signatures, falling directly under PSBT handling.
categories.rationale: PartiallySignedTransaction::AddInput fails to clear Taproot and MuSig2 signatures and nonces when adding inputs, leaving stale, invalid signatures on joined PSBTs. While this fixes an inconsistency where only legacy signatures were cleared, joining already-signed Taproot PSBTs is an edge workflow that is reasonably deferrable without risking fund loss.
